u0: Idle, final state: no client is waiting, no order is open, and the siren is silent. Current work is complete; monitor for the next ring or client arrival. A ring sends you to u1, while a new client sends you to u2 if the siren is silent or u3 if it is ringing.
u1: The siren is ringing and no client order is pending. Go to the siren switch and toggle it off; that returns you to u0. If a client arrives before you silence it, continue with the client while tracking the siren status: u3 if it is still ringing, u2 if it has been silenced.
u10: Prepared food has just slipped from your hands while the order is taken and the siren is silent. Your hands are empty and the prepared food lies next to you. Pick it up on the very next move, returning to u6 with prepared food and the client as the next goal; missing that immediate pickup incurs the recovery penalty and resumes the prepared-food stage, so you still need prepared food in hand to serve.
u11: Prepared food has just slipped from your hands while the order is taken and the siren is ringing. Your hands are empty and the prepared food lies next to you. Pick it up on the very next move; success leads to u7 if the siren is still ringing or u6 if it is silent, after which you must silence the siren and serve. Toggling the switch instead of recovering, or failing to pick up, incurs the recovery penalty.
u12: The client's order is taken, the siren is silent, and your hands are empty with no food fetched. Go to the pantry and pick up raw food, which leads to u4 if the siren stays silent or u5 if it rings; if the pickup slips immediately, go to u8 and recover it next move. Then keep the siren off and prepare the food at the stove.
u13: The client's order is taken, the siren is ringing, and your hands are empty with no food fetched. Go to the siren switch and turn it off, leading to u12, then fetch food from the pantry. If you pick up while it is still ringing you move to u5 and must still silence the siren before preparing and serving; a pickup slip moves to u9 for immediate recovery.
u2: A client is waiting and has not yet given an order; the siren is silent. Go to the client spot and toggle to take the order, then continue fetching or preparing food. If the siren starts before the order is taken, move to u3 and silence it.
u3: A client is waiting and has not yet given an order, while the siren is ringing. Address the siren by going to the switch and turning it off; then take the client's order. If you take the order while the siren is still ringing, progress moves to u5 or u13 depending on whether you hold food.
u4: The client's order is taken, the siren is silent, and you normally hold raw, unprepared food. Take it to the stove and toggle to prepare it, which leads to u6. If the siren starts, go to u5; if the food slips, go to u8 and recover it on the very next move. If a missed recovery left you empty-handed, fetch another portion first.
u5: The client's order is taken, you normally hold raw, unprepared food, and the siren is ringing. Go to the siren switch and turn it off, leading to u4; then prepare the food at the stove. Preparing while the siren rings moves you to u7, where you must still silence the siren before serving. If the food slips, recover it immediately via u9, or u8 if you also toggle the switch off.
u6: The client's order is taken, the siren is silent, and you normally hold prepared green food. Go to the waiting client and toggle to serve; a silent serve completes the task and returns to u0. If the siren starts, go to u7 and silence it before serving; if the food slips, go to u10 and pick it up next move. If empty-handed after a failed recovery, obtain prepared food before trying to serve.
u7: The client's order is taken, you normally hold prepared green food, and the siren is ringing. Do not serve while it is ringing: go to the switch and turn the siren off, leading to u6, then serve the client. If the food slips, recover it immediately via u11, or u10 if you also toggle the switch off. If empty-handed after a failed recovery, get prepared food before serving.
u8: Raw food has just slipped from your hands while the order is taken and the siren is silent. Your hands are empty and the food lies next to you, with the agent turned to face it. Pick it up on the very next move, returning to u4 with raw food and the stove as the next goal; missing that immediate pickup incurs the recovery penalty and resumes the raw-food stage, so still get food in hand before preparing.
u9: Raw food has just slipped from your hands while the order is taken and the siren is ringing. Your hands are empty and the food lies next to you. Pick it up on the very next move, then handle the siren and the stove; a successful pickup leads to u5 if the siren is still ringing or u4 if it is silent. Toggling the switch instead of recovering, or failing to pick up, incurs the recovery penalty.
